question: How many summits are assigned to the sixth, seventh, and eighth storeys?
premises: Seven summits are assigned to the seventh storey.
Three summits are assigned to the sixth storey.
The eighth storey is also included in this enumeration.
inference: The sixth storey has three summits, the seventh has seven, and the eighth is specified in the same scheme.
